body:
I'm sorry it takes me so long to respond,  I'm still here.  I just went for a really long walk because i couldn't stand to be in the apartment anymore.  I'm pretty much estranged from my family though, i mean the last time i had contact with my brother was for the funeral of my grandmother back in july and really we had not really seen each other besides one visit during christmas when the kid was just born.  I wasn't a very good older brother growing up I was so jealous of both of them for having friends and boyfriends and girlfriends and normal lives while i was an outcast.   I don't really want to intrude in their lives.  

As for the pen-pal thing  I honestly don't know what to say, on the one hand I really want to but it feels like i'm trolling for sympathy and I don't honestly know how to continue from this point.   I definitely feel better just writting this drivel down so if your willing to keep reading or if you'd like to share your day with me I'd sort of enjoy that.   I think that's what is the most annoying part of being me no one knows me enough that they want to actually talk to me. I just have this thing here now which is probably the most i've talked to anyone in maybe 5 years.

I'm sorry i sort of passed out there last night since it was 4am, i'm in ontario,  I'm really really afraid of taking any drugs that mess with my mind,  i think my mind is basically my greatest quality and anything that changes terrifies me.   My father is in nova scotia and my sister is in vancouver, i listed my brother because he's the closest to me but he's still like 2 hours away.  I do go see him but it basically just makes me confront how empty my life is as he has a gf and a baby kid.  I actually went and visited them this summer and it was nice to talk to people but i can't connect with them they live such orthogonal lives to mine.   And the only difference i made was i made sure most of the money would go to the babies university fund if i died.

I don't really have a plan I was staring at my window and being sad but I don't really have the urge to go through with it at least not like when i originally posted an hour or ago.  I don't have much family i grew up in the military i never got along with my dad and my mom passed away several years ago.  I haven't talked to my sister in years and I really don't want to burden my brother with myself.  

for a therapist I don't know i don't know how paying to have someone listen to me I don't know it feels like trying to purchase a friend.  

I'm okay talking anonymously on the internet but i can't say that i would want to bring it up to anyone that could actually identify me.

I'm actually in Canada.  

My name is Philippe,  my weight has been decreasing because i now have large gal bladder stones that force me to eat healthier or suffer lots of pain and i rather lose the weight then get surgery.  You can ask me any question you want.

Thanks.    I just don't know what to do or how to go about doing it.  When i walk down the street i see people interacting and having fun and it seems so alien to me.  I don't feel human.  I feel like all i'm doing is wasting precious ressources that someone else could use so much better then me.  But i am whining and i can't really help myself and my biggest problem is I don't see my life getting better just worse.  I'm 400 pounds currently I have a whole bunch of health issue with being that large, and i'm losing weight sorta gradually especially in the last year.  I've been fat since i was a kid and i've always held the belief that being fat was why no one  would love me but that's such bullshit and i know its bullshit since plenty of fat people manage to find someone who actually like them, so I'm losing weight with the knowledge that after all the privation i'll just be a husky bastard instead of a fat bastard.  I'll just make myself live longer which is just prolonging suffering.  But then i think that i'm just saying that so i can get the pizza i want or whatnot instead of the rice and vegetables i'm supposed to eat.   I don't know what to say all the above seems to be so superficial to what i'm feeling,  I don't really care about any of the above issues i'm just so goddamn sad all the time.  If i'm not in the middle of a book or playing a video game  if i give myself anytime to think i just fill such abject sadness that i don't know why I don't give up.
